{{Quote|This is the Kuat Shipyard, we have come under Rebel attack. Requesting assistance.|Communications officer sending out a distress signal to Imperial ships in the area|<ref name="Star Wars: Empire at War">''[[Star Wars: Empire at War]]''</ref>}}
A '''Communications Officer''' served the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] at the [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat]] [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyards]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He was present at the shipyards during the [[Space Battle at Kuat]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]]. As the shipyards were destroyed by [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Corvette/Legends|corvettes]], he repeatedly contacted the [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] ''[[Tyranny]]'', which was usually stationed at the shipyards, but had been transferred to [[Fresia/Legends|Fresia]], in defense of the planet because of the upcoming Rebel strike to steal fighter prototypes. The ship's [[Unidentified Tyranny commander|commander]] refused to reply until the communications officer activated [[Emergency Code Zero (Imperial)|Emergency Code Zero]] which required the ''Tyranny'' to report to Kuat immediately.
